science.description_1: Language acquisition is not just memorization. It is the physical restructuring of your brain. We use scientifically proven methods to specifically stimulate neural plasticity.
science.description_2: Through adaptive learning algorithms and cognitive triggers, we create new synaptic connections that make the decisive difference, especially in adulthood.

location.label: LOCATION
location.title: Location
location.subtitle: In the Heart of Hanover
location.description: Our courses take place at leisure center Vahrenwald – a modern, cultural meeting point with excellent accessibility. Only 10 minutes from the main station.

card1.title: Why standard government courses often fail.
card1.text: Traditional methods (like those of the BAMF) often take no account of the biological changes in the brain after 50. In our current research at TU Braunschweig and the University of Hannover, we show: Successful learning in old age requires adapted methods that use natural neuroplasticity instead of overwhelming it.

items.name: TU Braunschweig
items.desc: Studies GFL/GSL (German as a Foreign/Second Language)

items.name: Leibniz University Hannover
items.desc: Master of Education & Bachelor of Science (Biology & German)

items.name: Specialization
items.desc: Certified competence in multilingualism and intercultural education

card3.title: Proven in practice.
card3.text: Since 2023, we have been leading German courses for the Ukrainian Association in Lower Saxony e.V. Through our work in welcome classes and as a student assistant in the field of German as a Second Language at the University of Hannover, we know the real hurdles you face.

card4.title: Two mother tongues: German & Russian.
card4.text: We grew up completely bilingual. This allows us to explain complex rules directly in your native language. To understand your perspective as a learner even better, we are currently learning Turkish ourselves – so we know exactly how it feels to start all over again.

about_v2.headline: Anastasia Sitov - Founder & Instructor
about_v2.body: Growing up bilingual, I understand the challenges of language learning from my own experience. My approach combines neurobiological insights with individual learning strategies – for learning at your own pace that actually works.

sections.title: § 1 Scope of Application, Provider
content: (1) These General Terms and Conditions (GTC) apply to all contracts for participation in language courses, language training, private lessons, online courses, and other services of the SmartGerman Language School (hereinafter "Language School").
Provider:
SmartGerman Language School
Hüttenstraße 24a, 30165 Hannover, Germany
E-Mail: info@smart-german.com
Authorized Representative: Anastasia Sitov
(2) Deviating or supplementary conditions of the participant are only binding if the Language School confirms this in writing.

sections.title: § 2 Subject of Contract
content: (1) The subject of the contract is the services specified in the respective course description (scope of services, course duration, dates, teaching materials). The course description is an integral part of the contract.
(2) Minor changes in the course schedule, teaching staff, or class times are permissible, provided that the overall character of the course is not significantly impaired.
(3) Online instruction is conducted via common video conferencing software (e.g., Microsoft Teams). The participant is responsible for a suitable internet connection and technical equipment.

sections.title: § 3 Registration and Conclusion of Contract
content: (1) Registration can be made online via the website, by e-mail, by written registration form, or personally on site and constitutes a binding offer by the participant.

(2) In the case of written registration using a paper form, the contract is concluded with your signature on the registration form. You will receive a written or e-mailed confirmation of registration.

(3) In the case of online registration, the contract is concluded as soon as the Language School confirms the registration in writing (e.g., by e-mail). The registration confirmation can be combined with the invoice for the course fee.
(4) The Language School reserves the right to reject registrations for good cause (e.g., overcrowding, inappropriate language level).

sections.title: § 4 Prices, Payment Conditions, Default
content: (1) The currently valid prices are those listed in the price overview published on the website. All prices are final prices. According to § 19 UStG, no sales tax is charged.

(2) The course fee is to be paid in advance for the upcoming month. Upon payment, the participant acquires access to the courses of this month. An automatic extension of the contract does not take place.
(3) Payment is made by bank transfer after receipt of invoice, unless otherwise agreed.
Bank details:

BIC: NTSBDEB1XXX

(4) Invoices must be paid within 14 days of receipt. Failure to comply with this deadline may result in default interest in accordance with statutory regulations.
(5) If the participant is in default of payment, the statutory default regulations (§ 288 BGB) apply. The Language School is entitled to suspend participation until outstanding amounts are settled.

sections.title: § 5 Right of Withdrawal (Consumers / Distance Contracts)
content: (1) If the contract was concluded via distance selling (e.g., by e-mail or online registration), the participant, who is a consumer within the meaning of § 13 BGB, has a statutory right of withdrawal.
(2) The details result from the following cancellation policy.

sections.title: Cancellation Policy
content: Right of withdrawal:
You have the right to withdraw from this contract within fourteen days without giving any reason.
The withdrawal period is fourteen days from the day of the conclusion of the contract.

To exercise your right of withdrawal, you must inform us (SmartGerman Language School, Hüttenstraße 24a, 30165 Hannover, E-Mail: info@smart-german.com) by means of a clear statement (e.g., by e-mail or letter) of your decision to withdraw from this contract.
To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient for you to send your communication concerning your exercise of the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period has expired.
Consequences of withdrawal:

If you withdraw from this contract, we will reimburse to you all payments received from you, promptly and at the latest within 14 days from the day on which we received your notification of withdrawal.
For this repayment, we use the same means of payment that you used for the original transaction, unless expressly agreed otherwise with you.

Compensation for value: If you requested that the service (e.g., the course) begin during the withdrawal period, you must pay us a reasonable amount corresponding to the proportion of the services already provided up to the time you inform us of the exercise of the right of withdrawal compared to the total scope of the services provided for in the contract.
Special note on premature expiration:

The right of withdrawal expires in the case of a contract for the provision of services even if we have completely provided the service and have only begun to perform the service after you have given your express consent to this and at the same time confirmed your knowledge that you lose your right of withdrawal upon complete performance of the contract by us.

sections.title: § 6 Non-participation / Illness
content: (1) The course fee covers access to the courses in the respective month. In case of non-participation in individual teaching units (e.g., due to illness or vacation), there is no claim for reimbursement or replacement hours.
(2) On a goodwill basis, the Language School may offer make-up opportunities or replacement dates, provided this is organizationally possible.

sections.title: § 7 Cancellation by the Language School / Replacement Services
content: (1) If classes are cancelled for reasons for which the Language School is responsible (e.g., illness of the teacher) and no replacement date can be offered, the pro rata course fee will be refunded.
(2) Further claims, in particular damages, are excluded, unless there is intent or gross negligence.

sections.title: § 8 Liability
content: (1) The Language School is liable only for intent and gross negligence. In cases of simple negligence, it is liable only for the breach of essential contractual obligations (cardinal obligations) and limited to the typical, foreseeable damage.
(2) For damages resulting from injury to life, body, or health, statutory liability applies without limitation.
(3) The Language School assumes no guarantee for a specific learning success.
(4) Liability for loss or damage to personal belongings is assumed only in cases of intent or gross negligence.

sections.title: § 9 Copyright / Course Materials
content: Course materials are protected by copyright and may be used exclusively for personal use. Passing on, duplication, or publication is prohibited without the express written consent of the Language School.

sections.title: § 10 Contract Duration
content: (1) With payment of the course fee, a contract for participation in the course offer of the respective month is concluded.
(2) An automatic extension does not take place. For every further month, a new registration and payment is required.

sections.title: § 11 Data Protection
content: The collection and processing of personal data takes place in accordance with the GDPR and the BDSG. Further information can be found in the privacy policy on the website of the Language School.

sections.title: § 12 Final Provisions
content: (1) German law applies.
(2) The contract language is German.
(3) If the participant is a consumer, the statutory place of jurisdiction of their residence applies.
